# Synthetic study (generated)

**Simulated programs, not real ones.** Generated by `pcg.synthetic`; see its module text for the scenarios.
Each cell: 250 simulated programs. IV uses parameters estimated from 400 simulated single-fault programs of the well-specified scenario.
